svg.aria-label: Alternative: lightbulb with a dotted bridge and open center
svg.title: Alternative: lightbulb with a dotted bridge and open center
svg.desc: The equally bright Resolution bulb contains a dotted bridge-like filament and an open circle. They mark a viable interpretation offered to remove a difficulty without committing to it as the actual explanation. The dotted route is provisional, not a broken or invalid defense.
